title: Welcome
headline: Modern point of sale for
lead: Sell faster, take partial payments and installments, accept bank EMI, keep stock in sync and message customers — all in one place.
f_pos_text: Barcode-ready POS with drafts, split payments and A4 or thermal receipts.
f_installments_text: Down payment, flexible schedules, late fees and bank EMI tracking.
f_inventory_text: Branches, warehouses, variations and stock movements in real time.
f_reports_text: Daily to yearly sales, charts and PDF, CSV or Excel exports.
f_sms_text: Sale receipts, due reminders and festival greetings with any SMS vendor.
f_languages_text: English, বাংলা, العربية, Español and हिन्दी with right-to-left support.
